Bundled NIBTools component

Author: Peter Rittwage and contributors; based on MNIB by Markus Brenner.
Official repository: https://github.com/rittwage/nibtools
Release source: 20241120, commit 7bd20898c325a0e0036167f5a8b2fa66319154d3
Source archive: NIBTools-source-20241120.zip
Source download: https://api.github.com/repos/rittwage/nibtools/zipball/20241120

OptiMiyoo builds nibconv.exe from this unmodified source for AMD64 Windows.
The upstream executable strips relocation information and cannot start in
Windows AppContainer. This build retains relocations and supports the same
conversion formats. It does not need the physical-drive OpenCBM components.
SHA-256: 91ffa3f66ec00b2648613bbcfea32d162b72dd260c2f188dc7562045989b68ff

Build tool: official Zig 0.17.0 (Clang/MinGW-w64 C toolchain).
Download: https://ziglang.org/download/0.17.0/zig-x86_64-windows-0.17.0.zip
Compiler archive SHA-256:
b5663f69581dcf391293fbf16c06cb80d81d806545ce618b4d0bab7f0eb8c428

To reproduce, extract the source and compiler archives, enter the source root,
set SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1732060800 (2024-11-20 UTC), and run the following command
with zig.exe on PATH. The fixed date makes the built-in version text reproducible.

zig cc -target x86_64-windows-gnu -std=c99 -O1 -s -Wno-format -Wno-pointer-sign -Wno-error=date-time -DWIN32 -D_XOPEN_SOURCE=500 -I include/WINDOWS -o nibconv.exe nibconv.c gcr.c prot.c fileio.c crc.c md5.c lz.c

COPYING.ZIG and COPYING.MINGW preserve the bundled toolchain runtime notices.
LICENSE.txt is the GPL-3.0 text added by the upstream repository after this release:
https://github.com/rittwage/nibtools/blob/a549c18c5267c2b1e595aa65396399e12a0201b5/LICENSE
Original copyright and third-party notices remain in the source archive.

README-upstream.txt describes all NIBTools programs. OptiMiyoo uses only nibconv
to convert existing image files; hardware disk reading and writing are not used.
